mathematical_audit.integrality: Both lambda coordinates are coefficients of integral formal power series because every negative-binomial coefficient in (1+y^2)^-k is integral.
mathematical_audit.inherited_forced_divisor: Canonical Item200 proves the exact squarefree rank-zero Cartier product F_m=G_m divides both lambda coordinates, every factor of F_m is at most 6m, and log F_m=C_F*m+o(m), with C_F=-4 log 2+pi/sqrt(3)+3 log 3. Item415 does not rebook this content.
mathematical_audit.interval_rederivation: For 4m+1<ell<6m, Frobenius truncation replaces the two kernels below degree ell by polynomials of degrees ell-2m-1 and ell-2m, below the target degrees. This independently recovers only Item200's j=0 subproduct.
mathematical_audit.all_depth_quotient: Since every target prime p is greater than 6m, F_m is a p-unit. Thus mu_s=lambda_s/F_m is integral and has exactly the same p-adic valuation as lambda_s. Combining this with Item390 gives the exact all-depth carrier c_m^>=(gcd(|mu_0|,|mu_1|))_(p>6m).
mathematical_audit.height_and_ceiling: Item390 gives |lambda_0|<3*136^m and |lambda_1|<21*136^m for all sufficiently large m, with at least one nonzero. Dividing the nonzero bound by F_m yields c_m^><21*136^m/F_m and therefore limsup log(c_m^>)/(6m)<=(log136-C_F)/6.
mathematical_audit.marked_transport: The fixed-gap congruences identify the Item390 lambda pair with the evaluated Item411 generator pair modulo p. Solving the determinant-6 transport at n=-6m-1 mod p gives the displayed integral A/B transform of determinant -2(4m+1), a p-unit for p>6m. Hence it preserves all valuation depths and the Frobenius-selected branch.
mathematical_audit.overlap: The reduction is an upper bound for the disjoint strictly-large component only. F_m was already removed in the frozen normalization and may overlap earlier Cartier strata. Item393 prevents subtracting this component upper bound from a global total-content upper bound without a lower bound for the component.
